name: validate_phone
description: Validate & parse a phone number against the E.164 / ITU calling-code plan (keyless, offline). Detects the country, normalizes to E.164, and checks the national-number length is plausible. Pass an international number (e.g. "+33 1 23 45 67 89") OR a national number plus a `country` ISO code (e.g. phone="020 7946 0958", country="GB"). Does NOT determine carrier or mobile-vs-landline (that needs a keyed HLR lookup).

phone.description: The phone number to validate (international "+.." form, or national form with `country`).

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE") used when `phone` is in national (non-+) form.

name: country_calling_codes
description: Look up international calling (dialing) codes. With no args, lists all. Pass `query` to filter by country name, ISO code, or calling code (e.g. "germany", "DE", "49").

query.description: Country name, ISO alpha-2 code, or calling code to search for.
